name: Monmusu Fantasy Series - La Violeta Nocturna
source:
An adventurer returns to his hometown after several months abroad.

He visits his favorite inn to spend the night, but when he was about to sleep he heard noises in his room, only to discover a strange intruder. A rather shy succubus who dies of embarrassment just thinking about sex.
translation:
一位冒险家在国外几个月后回到家乡。

他来到他最喜欢的旅馆过夜，但当他准备睡觉时，却听到房间里有声音，却发现有一个奇怪的入侵者。一个相当害羞的魅魔，一想到性就会尴尬而死。
